name: volatility_adjusted_momentum_126
hypothesis: Risk-adjusting the medium-term 126-session price return by dividing it by the trailing 126-session daily volatility reduces exposure to high-beta, crash-prone stocks and prioritizes assets with steady directional trends.
overfit_risk: Using matching lookback windows (126 days) for both return and volatility may introduce structural bias if volatility dynamics operate on a shorter timescale (e.g., 21 days), potentially lagging during rapid regime shifts.
